title: Assistant Manager Accountant - Finance
description:
**Summary:** 




 The Senior Accountant will be part of Grant Thornton UAE’s Finance team and will operate as an offshore finance resource supporting core Accounts Payable activities, month\-end close processes, reconciliations, and finance operations. The role is designed to strengthen processing discipline, improve turnaround times, support audit\-ready documentation, and create a scalable offshore finance capability that can expand over time as the firm’s operational requirements grow. This role is intended to form the foundation for a scalable offshore finance support model. As processes stabilise, the Senior Accountant may take on responsibility for training junior offshore resources, documenting standard operating procedures, monitoring service levels, and supporting the transition of additional transactional finance activities offshore. The long\-term objective is to build a reliable, well\-controlled, and cost\-effective offshore finance capability that complements the onshore team while maintaining Grant Thornton’s quality, responsiveness, and control standards.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 The Senior Accountant will be expected to operate with discipline, responsiveness, and a strong control mindset. The role requires close coordination with the UAE\-based finance team, timely escalation of issues, and a proactive approach to improving AP and month\-end processes. The individual should be comfortable working in a professional services environment where deadlines, confidentiality, accuracy, and stakeholder service are critical.
 


* Process vendor invoices accurately and in line with internal approval workflows, delegated authority limits, tax requirements, and finance policies.
* Support the Accounts Payable cycle, including invoice booking, payment preparation, vendor statement reconciliations, ageing review, and follow\-up on outstanding items.
* Maintain complete and audit\-ready supporting documentation for invoices, purchase orders, approvals, contracts, payment evidence, and reconciliations.
* Assist with month\-end close activities, including accruals, prepayments, expense analysis, bank reconciliations, intercompany reconciliations, and general ledger review.
* Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring reconciling items are clearly explained, supported, and resolved on a timely basis.
* Support cost analysis and expense coding across business units, departments, and projects to improve accuracy of management reporting.
* Coordinate with onshore finance colleagues, engagement teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to resolve invoice queries and payment\-related matters.
* Assist with VAT, corporate tax, audit, and statutory information requests by collating schedules, supporting documents, and transaction\-level evidence.
* Contribute to process improvements, standard operating procedures, checklists, and automation opportunities within AP and month\-end processes.
* Provide support for ad hoc finance activities, reporting packs, data clean\-up, and system implementation or enhancement projects as required.



  





**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications/Skills:** 



* High attention to detail with the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and control gaps.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to manage recurring deadlines with limited supervision.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to follow up professionally with stakeholders.
* Good problem\-solving skills and a practical approach to resolving transaction, reconciliation, and process issues.
* Ability to work across time zones and maintain service discipline in an offshore support model.
* Commitment to confidentiality, data integrity, and compliance with internal policies.
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, commerce, or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent is preferred.
* Minimum 4 to 6 years of relevant finance and accounting experience, ideally within a professional services, audit, accounting, or consulting environment.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Accounts Payable, month\-end close, reconciliations, general ledger accounting, and financial reporting support.
* Good understanding of accounting principles, internal controls, documentation standards, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience working with ERP systems and finance workflow tools; strong Microsoft Excel capability is essential.
* Experience supporting offshore, shared services, or distributed finance teams would be an advantage.

* Excellent communication, organization, and time management skills with high attention to detail and ability to adapt and apply learnings effectively. Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage relationships across international teams, and make informed decisions in a fast\-paced, multi\-client environment.

title: Director – Digital Transformation, Integrated Finance
description:
**How does this Job align to our Strategy?** 




  





 At the core of Tata Consumer Products' business approach lie six strategic pillars that serve as the foundation for its growth and success: Strengthening \& Accelerating our Core Business, Driving Digital and Innovation, Unlocking Synergies, Creating a Future\-Ready Organization, Exploring New Opportunities and Embedding Sustainability.
 



  





 This job opportunity closely aligns with the key strategic pillar, which is Driving Digital \& Innovation, creating a Future\-Ready Organization, and Exploring New Opportunities.
 



 This role is instrumental in reshaping Integrated Finance through digital transformation \& innovation, aligning technology, processes, and stakeholder needs to drive strategic agility and operational excellence. The incumbent will bring strong digital acumen, finance domain expertise to deliver scalable, data\-driven solutions that enhance visibility, accelerate execution, and improve decision\-making across the enterprise. The role demands strong ownership, stakeholder engagement, and a sharp focus on delivering value through scalable, data\-driven products
 



  





**What are the Key Deliverables in this role?** 




  





**Financial Outcomes** 




**1\. Lead the Next Wave of Finance Transformation** 




 • Own and drive the enterprise Finance Digital Transformation agenda across Corporate Finance,
 



 Business Finance, GCC and other Finance functions.
 



 • Build the roadmap for the future of Finance, combining process simplification, standardization,
 



 automation, data, analytics, Generative AI and Agentic AI.
 



 • Reimagine end\-to\-end Finance processes rather than simply digitizing existing ways of working.
 



 • Drive transformation across Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Record\-to\-Report (R2R), FP\&A, MIS and
 



 management reporting, Taxation, Treasury, Controls, Internal Audit and other Finance processes.
 



 • Establish measurable transformation outcomes and ensure adoption and value realization.
 



  





**2\. Build an Agentic Finance Operating Model** 




 • Develop an agentic framework for Finance, identifying where intelligent agents can automate
 



 activities, augment Finance professionals or fundamentally redesign processes.
 



 • Build a prioritized portfolio of Finance agents across transactional, analytical, reporting, control and
 



 decision\-support processes.
 



 • Move Finance progressively from workflow\-based automation and RPA towards intelligent and
 



 autonomous execution where appropriate.
 



 • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms, ERP, Finance applications, data platforms and existing
 



 automation.
 



 • Establish appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop controls, governance, security and accountability for AI driven Finance processes.
 



 • Continuously evaluate emerging AI capabilities and translate them into practical enterprise Finance
 



 use cases.
 



  





**3\. Deliver Quantifiable Business Value** 




 Every major transformation initiative should be linked to one or more measurable outcomes:
 



 • Top\-line benefit: better commercial decisions, improved revenue realization, working\-capital or
 



 business\-performance impact.
 



 • Bottom\-line benefit: direct cost reduction, leakage prevention, better procurement economics and
 



 operating\-cost improvement.
 



 • Efficiency benefit: measurable productivity improvement, FTE/headcount capacity released or
 



 avoided, faster cycle times and greater process automation.
 



 Build a disciplined mechanism to baseline, track and report these benefits rather than measuring
 



 transformation primarily through project delivery.
 



  





**4\. Transform and Partner with the Global Capability Centre** 




 • Partner closely with the Global Capability Centre serving multiple businesses, customers and
 



 geographies.
 



 • Identify opportunities for process consolidation, standardization and automation across the GCC.
 



 • Drive productivity and operating leverage through AI, agents, automation and redesigned processes.
 



 • Help evolve the GCC from a transaction\-processing organization towards an increasingly digital,
 



 analytical and AI\-enabled Finance capability centre.
 



 • Establish productivity, service, quality and efficiency measures and continuously improve them.
 



  





**5\. Act as the Digital Business Partner to Finance Leadership** 




 • Partner closely with the Group CFO, India CFO, Business Finance CFOs and their leadership teams.
 



 • Understand Finance and business priorities and translate them into transformation agendas and
 



 executable digital products and programs.
 



 • Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities where technology, data and AI can materially
 



 change Finance outcomes.
 



 • Bring an external perspective on emerging Finance practices, platforms and AI capabilities.
 



 • Build strong alignment between Finance, Digital \& Technology, GCC, implementation partners and other stakeholders.
 



  





**6\. Standardize and Simplify Finance Processes** 




 • Establish common process architecture and standards across Finance.
 



 • Reduce process fragmentation, unnecessary customization and manual interventions.
 



 • Drive harmonization across businesses and geographies wherever economically and operationally
 



 appropriate.
 



 • Build strong process ownership, controls, KPIs and governance.
 



 • Ensure technology follows the redesigned process rather than automating inefficient legacy processes.
 



  





**Customer Service** 




 • Partner with Finance leadership to shape and execute the Finance Transformation roadmap.
 



 • Translate business needs into scalable digital products and capabilities that enhance decision\-making and user experience.
 



 • Strengthen reporting, governance, and management information frameworks to improve business insight and responsiveness.
 



  





**Internal Process** 




 • Lead enterprise\-wide transformation across P2P, R2R, FP\&A, MIS, Taxation, and other finance domains.
 



 • Drive ERP, Data, Analytics, and AI integration to create a connected and future\-ready finance operating model.
 



 • Ensure robust governance across data, security, compliance, and digital product delivery while
 



 embedding agile ways of working.
 



 • Lead and safeguard agile methodology and scrum practices to ensure delivery discipline.
 



  





**Innovation and Learning** 




 • Build digital and AI capabilities across the Finance organization, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
 



 • Accelerate adoption of Data, Analytics, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions across Corporate Finance, Business Finance, Taxation, Internal Audit, and GCC.
 



 • Establish strategic partnerships and innovation programs to continuously enhance Finance maturity and business value
 



  





**What are the Critical success factors for the Role ?** 




**Experience** 




 • 12\+ years of relevant professional experience. No upper experience limit.
 



 • Significant experience in Finance transformation, Finance business partnering, digital transformation or technology\-enabled Finance change.
 



 • Should have either:
 



 • Worked as a Finance Business Partner / Finance transformation leader in a large enterprise,
 



 or
 



 •Anchored major Finance transformation programs as part of a leading consulting or System
 



 Integration organization.
 



 • Demonstrated experience working with senior Finance stakeholders, preferably CFO\-level
 



 leadership.
 



 • Experience delivering complex transformation across multiple businesses, functions or geographies.
 



 • Experience working with Shared Services / Global Capability Centres is strongly preferred.
 



  





**Finance \& Transformation Knowledge** 




 Strong understanding and preferably implementation/transformation experience across several of the following:
 



 • Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)
 



 • Record\-to\-Report (R2R)
 



 • FP\&A
 



 • MIS and management reporting
 



 • Financial planning and performance management
 



 • Finance data and analytics
 



 • Taxation and controls
 



 • Internal Audit
 



 • Shared Services / GCC
 



 • ERP\-enabled Finance processes
 



  





 The individual does not need to be the deepest functional specialist in every Finance domain, but should understand Finance sufficiently well to challenge processes, engage credibly with CFOs and translate Finance problems into transformation opportunities.
 



  





**AI and Digital Capability** 




 • Strong understanding of the emerging application of Generative AI and Agentic AI in Finance.
 



 • Ability to identify processes that can be redesigned using agents rather than simply applying
 



 automation to existing workflows.
 



 • Understanding of enterprise data, analytics, ERP and integration architecture.
 



 • Ability to combine Finance process knowledge with technology and AI possibilities.
 



 • Exposure to RPA, intelligent automation and digital Finance platforms is valuable, but the mindset
 



 should extend beyond traditional RPA.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Candidates should have a strong academic foundation from a reputed institution. Relevant qualifications may include:
 



 • CA / ICWA (CMA) or MBA in Finance, General Management or Technology from a premier
 



 institution
 



 • Engineering degree combined with an MBA or significant Finance transformation experience
 



 • Other equivalent professional Finance qualifications combined with substantial transformation
 



 experience
 



 An engineering/technology background combined with strong Finance and business experience would be particularly valuable for this role.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description:
**Job Description**
 Titel: Senior Finance Business Partner
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Shift timing: 11:00AM – 8:00PM IST
   

  

 Experience: 8 – 13 Years
   

  

 Introduction to the job
   

  

 Act as the primary financial business partner to the Technology function, owning the full budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis cycle for a \~$35M Non\-Employee IT expense base supporting 400\+ employees. This role goes beyond data consolidation: it requires proactively engaging Technology leadership in business discussions, independently translating those discussions into financial numbers, and delivering decision\-quality insight, dashboards and follow\-through on actions — reducing the need for Director\-level involvement in day\-to\-day business partnering.
   

  

**Some of the things you’ll be doing**
* Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as the first point of contact for Technology leadership on all financial matters, independently engaging in business discussions.
* Proactively ask the right questions of Technology, Procurement and Vendor Management stakeholders to understand cost drivers, new initiatives, vendor contracts and renewal terms ahead of time.
* Build strong, trust\-based relationships across the Technology organization to gain early visibility into spend decisions and changes.
* Budgeting \& Forecasting
* Own end\-to\-end Non\-EE budgeting and forecasting for the $35M Technology cost base across all managed ERPs.
* Download, consolidate and reconcile transaction\-level data from NetSuite, SAP, Tally and other regional ERPs, mapping consistently to EPM cost categories.
* Partner with Technology leaders to validate assumptions, vendor renewals, contract changes and new project spend ahead of each budget/forecast cycle.
* Variance Analysis \& Commentary
* Deliver high\-quality, insight\-led variance commentary (Actuals vs Budget/Forecast) that clearly explains root causes and business drivers rather than restating numbers.
* Prepare a “no\-surprises” analysis ahead of monthly/quarterly reviews, anticipating leadership questions.
* Reporting \& Dashboards
* Maintain and continuously improve the Power BI Technology dashboard (Non\-EE, EE and headcount views), ensuring accuracy and timely refresh.
* Enable self\-service reporting for Technology and Finance stakeholders.
* Action Tracking \& Follow\-Through
* Maintain a structured action/issue tracker for open items with Procurement, Finops and BU stakeholders, ensuring clear ownership, due dates and closure.
* Drive items through to measurable resolution rather than repeated status\-only follow\-ups; escalate stalled items proactively.
* Governance \& Controls
* Ensure accurate cost centre, project and vendor cost allocation across Business Units.
* Support audit and compliance requirements relating to Technology spend and cost recharges.
* Process Leadership \& Automation
* Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual, multi\-ERP consolidation effort (e.g., Power Query/Power Automate).
* Guide and review the work of any junior finance resources supporting Technology reporting.


**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?**
* Qualified accountant, MBA (Finance), or equivalent senior finance qualification, with 8\+ years of overall finance experience including 3\+ years in a Finance Business Partnering / FP\&A role.
* Proven experience managing a large, multi\-million\-dollar Technology/IT cost base, including SAAS, licensing and vendor spend.
* Practical, hands\-on experience with multiple ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Tally or similar), including consolidation of data from disparate systems.
* Advanced Excel and Power BI skills; experience with Oracle EPM or similar planning/consolidation tools is preferred.
* Prior experience supporting or partnering with a Technology/IT organization is highly preferred.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to independently engage Technology leaders, ask probing questions, and translate discussions into financial plans without close supervision.
* Excellent variance analysis and financial storytelling skills, producing clear, insight\-driven commentary suited to senior leadership audiences.
* Strong sense of ownership and follow\-through, driving actions to closure and measurable outcomes rather than status updates alone.
* Ability to manage multiple ERP data sources, consolidating and reconciling large transaction volumes efficiently and accurately.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills across finance and non\-finance audiences.
* A process\-improvement and automation mindset, with the ability to simplify and streamline recurring reporting tasks.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Commercial and analytical thinking
* Ownership, follow\-through and cross\-functional coordination
* Constructive challenge and clear stakeholder communication
* Root\-cause analysis and structured problem\-solving
* Ability to convert detailed data into focused management actions
* Agility and adaptability in a fast\-changing technology cost environment


**Responsibilities**
* Own the full budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis cycle for the Technology function's \~35M Non\-Employee IT expense base.
* Proactively engage with Technology leadership, understanding their business needs and translating them into financial insights.
* Develop and deliver decision\-quality dashboards and reports, providing actionable financial intelligence to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Vendor Management, and FinOps teams to optimize expense management and contract negotiations.
* Partner with Corporate FP\&A and BU Controllers to ensure alignment and consistency in financial planning and reporting.
* Conduct in\-depth financial analysis and provide recommendations to support Technology's strategic initiatives and investment decisions.
* Monitor and analyze financial performance, identifying trends and variances, and proposing corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures, maintaining accurate records and documentation.
* Support the Director of Finance in special projects and ad\-hoc financial analyses as required.
* Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to enhance financial strategies and processes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a finance business partnering role, preferably in a technology or IT environment.
* Strong knowledge of financial principles, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Proficiency in using financial systems and tools such as NetSuite, SAP, Tally, Oracle EPM, and Power BI.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated experience in providing financial insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Familiarity with regional ERPs and experience working with diverse financial systems is preferred.
* A proactive and collaborative approach to working with cross\-functional teams.


**About Us**
 CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge\-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®
   

  

 Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.
   

  

 CSC is committed to creating a feeling of belonging through a diverse and growth\-oriented environment where everyone is valued.
   

  

 CSC colleagues have global career opportunities and excellent benefits, including annual success\-sharing bonuses or commission plans based on individual performance. To learn more, visit cscglobal.com/service/careers .

 We encourage candidates to apply directly to our website and not through third\-party sources.
   

  

*Disclaimer: The information above describes the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not intended to describe all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications.*
**About The Team**
 At CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to innovate, challenge the status quo, and anticipate the needs of our clients. We exceed expectations by adapting client ambitions and goals as our own. This Fierce Client Spirit has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 125 years. It’s also the reason we’re the trusted partner of many of the world’s most successful organizations.
   

  

 CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose values align with ours. We empower our colleagues to bring the right solutions to market to meet client demand. That’s why we are the leading provider of business administration and compliance solutions.
   

  

* CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people.
* We have won several employer recognition awards, including Top Workplace USA, Great Places to Work India, and Built In’s Best Places to Work.
* We offer fulfilling work and career opportunities. Most positions are filled with internal moves and employee referrals.

 As An IT Finance And Planning Manager You Will Have The Opportunity To Partner With IT And Business Leaders To Shape Technology Investment Strategy, Drive Financial Transparency, And Strengthen Operational Effectiveness Across The Technology Portfolio. Here, You Will Make An Impact By
   

  

* Setting the financial operating direction for the IT organization by leading the annual operating plan, budget establishment, forecasting cycles, and long\-range financial plans, and by establishing the guidelines, standards, and planning calendar that govern how IT financial decisions are made.
* Serving as the financial advisor to IT leadership, providing expert counsel on investment trade\-offs, funding alternatives, business cases, total cost of ownership, ROI, and affordability, and influencing decisions on where technology spend is prioritized, reduced, or redirected.

title: Sr Analyst Accounting & Financial Reporting
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
   

  

 Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

 An exciting opportunity to be a member of the Finance \& Accounting with responsibility for accounting, tax and financial reporting within the Empower. Responsibilities include formulating balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements that are subject to independent audit for the consolidated Company and its subsidiaries, and related supporting documents (financial statement tie\-outs) and certain functions related to the month\-end close process, including account reconciliations. In addition, responsibilities also include monthly reporting, reporting to regulatory bodies (foreign and domestic) and monitoring minimum regulatory capital requirements for certain subsidiaries. The senior analyst will also assist accounting on a monthly basis to prepare internal management reporting packages, including the supporting documents. Additionally, the role will assist with booking various monthly entries including cash and prepaids. The role includes interaction with other members of Corporate Accounting, Corporate Finance, Tax. Legal and Compliance, and Operations. In addition, the role will assist the Managers and Controller in various projects received from the CFO and the business units. This is a detailoriented position with stringent time deadlines, where time management, the ability to prioritize and multi\-task is essential.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and supporting analyses for the consolidated company and its subsidiaries, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
* Prepare financial statement tie\-outs, workpapers, variance analysis, and other supporting documentation for accounting, financial reporting, regulatory reporting, audit, and other reporting deliverables.
* Perform account reconciliations and analyze unusual or significant account fluctuations; research and document explanations for variances and resolve identified discrepancies.
* Identify financial and regulatory reporting issues, unusual transactions, data inconsistencies, and reconciliation differences; research and escalate matters requiring management attention.
* Prepare monthly internal management reporting packages and analyses highlighting financial results and significant variances.
* Calculate and monitor regulatory capital requirements for applicable subsidiary companies and prepare required regulatory reporting and filings to domestic and foreign regulatory agencies, including related reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and file applicable Bureau of Economic Analysis surveys.
* Support annual and interim external audits by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.
* Assist with tax\-related analyses, reporting requirements, and special projects.
* Partner with Corporate Accounting, Corporate Finance, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Operations, business units, and other stakeholders to complete financial reporting and project requirements.
* Support Managers, the Controller, and CFO with special projects and ad hoc financial analyses.


**What You Will Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or an equivalent field.
* Minimum 3 years of accounting, financial reporting, regulatory reporting, or related experience
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, STAT, and IFRS accounting bases.
* Ability to research accounting or regulatory codification and determine appropriate accounting treatment for new or non\-routine transactions.
* Ability to analyze financial data, investigate variances and reconciliation differences, and identify and escalate financial or regulatory reporting issues.
* Advanced or strong Microsoft Excel skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience using SAP. Experience using SAP or a comparable ERP system; SAP experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial reporting controls, reconciliations, and supporting documentation requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet stringent monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with multiple levels of management.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a team.


**What Will Set You Apart**
* Financial services industry experience.
* Experience preparing audited financial statements and supporting external audit requests.
* Experience with regulatory capital calculations and regulatory financial reporting.
* Experience supporting accounting or tax matters for multiple legal entities or subsidiaries.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Structured Finance – Transactions – CLO**
 EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit (“FSO”) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our FSO teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Structured Finance Team specializes in addressing varying needs of market participants in the securitization marketplace across asset classes, including asset\- backed securities (ABS), commercial mortgage\- backed securities (CMBS), residential mortgage\- backed securities (RMBS) and collateralized loan obligations (CLO). The securitization market is a dynamic marketplace, continuously evolving with new regulations and technological advances every day. This a great opportunity to work in this fast\-paced transaction business, support diverse engagement teams, work with a wide variety of clients and lead business development activities on strategic and global priority accounts.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 The primary role of the SFT transaction team is to perform agreed\-upon procedures (AUP) to help clients execute securitization transactions successfully.
   

  

* Checking the accuracy of our financial models by comparing calculations to the governing documents
* Creating cashflow/analytics models for securitized products, including but not limited to CDOs/CLOs (Collateralized Debt Obligations/Collateralized Loan Obligations)
* Transaction modeling and analytics, which involves cash flow modeling, recalculating certain collateral quality and concentration limitations set out in each transaction’s indenture, including bond principal and interest payments, credit\-enhancement, hedging instruments, fees and waterfalls for structured deals
* Construct independent cash flow and collateral models for various structured products utilizing Microsoft Excel
* Create and update detailed agreed upon procedure reports summarizing our results
* Comprehensive and methodical interpretation of prospectus/indenture information and deal structural features including but not limited to collateral, waterfall, triggers, hedges, paydown rules, loss allocation rules, and the ability to extract other pertinent information from prospectuses and indentures
* 
* Perform various analyses on complex excel and third party models (Like Bloomberg, various Rating Agency Portal, Markit etc) for the valuation of Structured Products
* Establish relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels. Consistently deliver quality client services. Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
* Demonstrate in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Remain current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Strong leadership, teaming, technical and relationship\- building skills and integrity. These skills along with having a consistent commitment to delivering only the highest quality of work products to your clients, will allow you to easily integrate into the SFT transaction team and reach your professional development goals.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A Post\-graduation in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline and approximately 2 years of related work experience.
* Excellent prioritization skills and a commitment to meeting client deadlines
* Strong communication skills for report writing, client presentations and client interactions
* Proficient skills with MS Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Flexibility and willingness to work more than standard hours when necessary to meet client deadlines
* Willingness to work in shift based on the role hired for


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Prior structured finance experience


**What We Look For**
* Individuals who demonstrate in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail \& accuracy
* Ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge and possess good business acumen
* Polished verbal and written communication skills in English


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Team Lead - Equity Index Data Management
description:
**Team Lead \- Equity Index Data — Job Description**
 Team Overview — Benchmarks \& Indices Operations
   

  

 Equity Index Data Management (EIDM) is part of the Benchmarks \& Indices Operations. We are a client\-focused, technology\-enabled team producing high\-value index data for internal and external clients. EIDM owns the underlying reference data used in the calculation of equity index products globally. We maintain LSEG intellectual property by generating and maintaining: ICB Classifications, Free Float, Voting Rights, Nationality, Universe preparation, Liquidity, and similar data points for Index Review, Rebalance, and Reconstitution cycles.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 The Team Lead \- Equity Index Data supervises the regional Bangalore team, owns global workflows, review deliverables and leads review planning with Index Review and Index Management. The role owns the performance metrics developed by Performance Enablement, supports the Manager in driving operational excellence and cross\-regional collaboration, and ensures quality and on\-time delivery across quarterly reviews, rebalances, and reconstitutions. The Team Lead will lead key initiatives, mentor team members, and contribute to product innovation, client engagement, vendor management, and automation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Supervision: Supervise and mentor the regional Bangalore team to ensure consistent delivery and adherence to FTSE Russell standards; provide coaching, feedback, and development support.
* Global Workflow Ownership: Own end\-to\-end global workflows (daily BAU, exception management process, quarterly and semi\-annual reviews and other production checkpoints), ensuring operational continuity, data integrity, and cross\-regional coordination.
* Review Planning: Lead review planning with Index Review and Index Management for quarterly reviews, rebalances, and reconstitutions, aligning schedules, dependencies, and quality gates.
* Performance Metrics Ownership: Own the performance matrix/metrics developed by Performance Enablement; monitor, report, and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Index Data Operations: Lead daily operations for index data validation, updates, and maintenance across global indices; uphold policy and ground rules compliance and delivery SLAs.
* Core Attribute Research \& Validation: Own research and validation of core index attributes including Free Float, Voting Rights, NICB/ICB classifications, and Country Classification.
* Timely Dataset Updates: Ensure timely and accurate updates to index dataset during review cycles, incorporating corporate actions and market events.
* Data Infrastructure: Maintain SQL databases, validation scripts, and reporting tools that support global index data workflows.
* Product \& Policy Collaboration: Provide data\-driven analysis to support Index Policy on potential ground\-rule or policy updates and during complex client queries (impact assessments and recommendations).
* New Product Support: Collaborate on new index product development by identifying relevant data points, historical datasets, and designing scalable data pipeline requirements.
* Automation \& Tools: Support automation initiatives using Power BI, Power Automate, and SQL to enhance data quality and reduce manual effort; contribute to AI\-based research tools and workflow automation with internal tech teams.
* Vendor Onboarding \& Evaluation: Assist in vendor onboarding and evaluation; conduct due diligence on coverage, quality, SLAs, and alignment with FTSE Russell standards; perform multi\-vendor comparisons and feasibility testing; coordinate UAT/parallel validations.
* Stakeholder Management: Liaise with Index Management, Index Policy, and Delivery teams to ensure smooth review cycles and data alignment across regions.
* Client Engagement: Manage post\-review client queries and provide clear, data\-driven explanations for index decisions consistent with methodology and policy.
* Governance, Risk \& Resilience: Manage compliance with global data governance and business continuity standards; support enterprise risk and resilience initiatives in collaboration with the Manager.


**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in index operations, reviews, rebalances \& reconstitution.
* Strong understanding of equity markets, index construction, and corporate actions.
* Proven ability to lead teams and drive cross\-functional initiatives; excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and automation tools; experience with AWS or BAW is a plus.


 Core Skills
   

  

* People leadership and mentoring; setting priorities, delegating effectively, and developing talent.
* Analytical rigour and problem\-solving; consistent interpretation and application of Index policies and ground rules.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including handling client\-facing explanations and escalations.
* Process discipline: documentation (SOPs, RCAs, QC feedback), control mindset, and continuous improvement orientation.
* Ability to manage complex operational cycles and drive improvements in data quality, governance, and efficiency across global workflows.

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**Analyst – GBS Finance Planning \& Performance Management
   

  

 Location: Benguluru, Karnataka**
**Role Overview**
 The Analyst will support the GBS Finance Planning \& Performance Management agenda across GCC India, GCC Mexico, broader GBS zones, non\-GCC components including NA, EPDM, WHQ, external vendor/tower ecosystems, and partners such as Genpact. The role will assist in preparing AOP and LE inputs, monthly reporting, variance analysis, accrual and true\-up support, intercompany recharge tracking, cross\-zone cost transfer coordination, and leadership review materials. This position is expected to work closely with finance managers, GBS stakeholders, accounting, procurement, vendor teams, and controllership to ensure accurate data, timely reporting, clear documentation, and smooth execution of core finance processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Financial planning and reporting support: Support AOP, LE, forecasting, and performance reporting activities for the assigned GBS scope, including data consolidation, budget input preparation, variance analysis, and review deck support.
* AOP and LE process coordination: Assist with budget tracker maintenance, cost center and package\-level data checks, service cost assumptions, upload templates, review comments, and follow\-ups required for timely submissions.
* Stakeholder coordination: Work with GCC, GBS zone, NA, EPDM, WHQ, tower, vendor, and finance stakeholders to collect inputs, validate movements, track open items, and support resolution of planning and reporting queries.
* Vendor and tower cost support: Assist in validating vendor cost data, Genpact inputs, billing trends, commitments, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoice details, and budget adherence for assigned areas.
* Management reporting support: Prepare and update GBS MBR, AOP, LE, variance, and performance review files by converting financial data into clear summaries, bridges, commentary, risks, opportunities, and pending action trackers.
* Accounting and control support: Support accruals, reclasses, true\-ups, intercompany recharges, cost allocations, and cross\-zone transfer documentation in coordination with accounting, controllership, and finance stakeholders.
* Process discipline and documentation: Maintain trackers, working files, supporting schedules, audit trails, and standard process documentation to ensure accuracy, repeatability, and timely execution of finance activities.


**Core Process Scope / Supporting Activities**
 This role supports finance operations for the broader GBS planning and reporting agenda, including GCC and non\-GCC components across GBS zones, NA, EPDM, WHQ, commercial management activities, PR/PO tracking, vendor invoice validation, intercompany recharge support, monthly accruals, GBS MBR reporting, LE updates, NA Services Package AOP uploads, yearly tracker maintenance, and Tier 1 project actuals tracking. The Analyst will be responsible for maintaining accurate files, coordinating inputs, performing initial data checks, highlighting variances, and supporting timely follow\-up with stakeholders.
   

  

**Experience Profile**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or related field; MBA, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent finance qualification will be an advantage.
* 5\+ years of experience in FP\&A, commercial finance, shared services finance, ZBB, GBS finance, accounting support, reporting, vendor cost tracking, or financial planning operations.
* Basic understanding of AOP, LE, forecasting, monthly close, variance analysis, accruals, recharge, cost center reporting, and management reporting processes.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with SAP HANA, financial reporting tools, Power BI, or planning systems will be preferred.
* Ability to work with large data sets, perform reconciliations, identify variances, maintain trackers, and summarize findings clearly for manager review.
* Good communication and collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate across finance, accounting, procurement, vendor, and business stakeholders in a global environment.
* Detail\-oriented approach with the ability to meet timelines, follow standard processes, document assumptions, and escalate risks or open items in a timely manner.

title: Associate - Central Expense & Headcount Management (P&A)
description:
**Job Description**
 About the Role
   

  

 Are you energized by turning numbers into narratives that shape strategic decisions? Our Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) team sits at the heart of the business, partnering with senior leaders to drive profitability, efficiency, and smart growth. As a
 **Senior Associate, Central Expense \& Headcount** 
 , you'll own two of our most important financial levers—
 **headcount and expenses** 
 —and translate complex data into insights that influence how the line of business operates and invests.
   

  

 Candidates Profile: The ideal candidate is a finance professional who combines strong analytical capability with business curiosity and stakeholder engagement. The individual should be comfortable working through financial planning, expense analysis, reporting and decision support. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys understanding business drivers, solving problems, improving processes, and providing insights that help senior stakeholders make informed decisions.
   

  

 Candidates from P\&A, FP\&A, CFO teams, corporate finance, valuation, financial research, banking finance, business management, consulting, or analytics roles are encouraged to apply. If you're a curious problem\-solver who thrives on both precision and impact, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Deliver insight, not just numbers — Build performance metrics, executive\-ready presentations, and analysis that help senior management make faster, better\-informed decisions.
* Own the financial cycle — Manage the end\-to\-end process for month\-end results, full\-year forecasts, and multi\-year budgets, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* Explain the “why” — Perform variance analysis to identify key drivers, and present clear commentary to FP\&A Managers and CFOs on changes versus prior forecasts and budgets.
* Modernize reporting — Design new dashboards and reports that deliver financial results to senior leaders efficiently and intuitively.
* Raise the bar on controls — Strengthen controls, streamline workflows, and introduce automation to reduce manual effort and risk.
* Lead transformation — Champion process improvement, automation, and dashboarding initiatives that elevate how the team works.
* Shape the reporting roadmap — Drive the analysis, design, and development of Expense and Headcount reporting from concept to delivery.


**Required Qualification**
* MBA, CA, CFA, CPA, Post Graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: Planning \& Analysis / FP\&A, CFO support or business finance, Corporate finance, Expense management, Financial reporting and management reporting, Financial research or valuation, Banking, financial services, consulting, or analytics
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; hands\-on experience with Essbase or any financial reporting system.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex issues and present financial insights clearly to senior audiences.
* A highly motivated self\-starter with strong time\-management and prioritization skills, able to thrive under tight deadlines.
* An inquisitive, diligent team player who is detail\-oriented, well\-organized, comfortable challenging peers constructively, and able to juggle competing priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work through large data sets and communicate conclusions concisely.


**Nice To Have (Preferred)**
* Proficiency in financial modeling.
* Experience with Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Alteryx, Power BI).
* Programming or automation skills (e.g., Python, SQL, VBA) to support process automation.

Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**

title: Risk - Credit Risk - Vice President - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**Who We Are**
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.
   

  

**Divisional Overview**
 The Risk division is responsible for credit, market and operational risk, model risk, independent liquidity risk, and insurance throughout the firm. Whether assessing the creditworthiness of the firm’s counterparties, monitoring market risks associated with trading activities, or offering analytical and regulatory compliance support, our work contributes directly to the firm’s success. The division is ideal for collaborative individuals who have strong ethics and attention to detail.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Credit Risk (CR) is responsible for managing the firm’s credit exposure to its trading and lending counterparties. Leveraging its extensive expertise in financial, credit and risk analysis, CR ensures that credit exposure to our counterparts is managed within the firm’s risk appetite. Staffed with more than 300 professionals, CR operates through 11 different offices around the world and credit professionals work closely with many areas of the firm. Given this structure, CR professionals gain diverse financial experience and a broad perspective on how the entire firm functions. The interaction with numerous departments and the range of projects that ensue allow for a challenging, varied and multi\-dimensional work environment.
   

  

**Credit Research Group**
 Credit Research Group plays a key role in assessing the credit and financial strength of corporate, financial institution, and sovereign counterparties by performing fundamental credit analysis through writing research reviews (covering both the counterparty and industry in which the counterparty transacts). This team is also responsible for the ongoing surveillance of all corporate/financial institution/sovereign counterparties, assignment of internal credit ratings, and participation in regulatory exams.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Qualifications**
**Responsibilities**
**Performing Counterparty Analysis And Risk Management**
* Assess the credit and financial strength of the firm's corporate borrowers and counterparts by performing fundamental credit analysis of counterparties using both quantitative and qualitative factors
* Review and provide recommendations for loan transactions, determine appetite and regulatory ratings, monitor credit trends in the portfolio, perform distressed analysis and estimate potential impairments
* Analyze the credit implications on corporate clients of various financial transactions including debt, equity and hybrid offerings, mergers and acquisitions, restructuring and share repurchases
* Build and maintain financial projection models
* Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership and answer questions relating to analysis performed
* Monitor counterparties for changes in creditworthiness and take appropriate action
* Perform portfolio\-level stress testing and scenario analysis to evaluate the impact of macroeconomic shocks on counterparty creditworthiness and portfolio performance.
* (Good to have) Demonstrated ability to design, test, and refine structured prompts—utilizing prompting techniques to guide Large Language Models (LLMs) in analyzing unstructured data sources, extracting key financial metrics


**Other Key Responsibilities Include**
* Working collaboratively with Risk Engineering colleagues to continually identify and solve for operating efficiency


 This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position. It is not intended to be a complete list of assigned duties but to describe a position level. The role shall be performed within a professional office environment. Goldman Sachs has health and safety polices that are available for all workers upon request. There are no specific health risks associate with the role.
   

  

* Spreading historical and projected financials in Credit systems and performing analysis including peer comparison to identify and document trends and anomalies necessary in assessing creditworthiness
* Coordinate with global colleagues in GS Risk teams as well as with other divisions
* Support key Risk governance and approval committees


**Qualifications**
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in business or finance, Masters preferred
* 7\-10 years of experience in a related corporate credit risk role with experience in credit analysis, ratings analysis, corporate finance and/or research desired
* Functional background or relevant experience in finance and accounting
* Highly motivated with strong academic background
* Team player with an ability to work effectively with colleagues in other regional offices
* Flexibility, ability to learn quickly
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments concurrently
* Familiarity with regulatory rating requirements and application of such guidance is preferred
* Strong analytical, presentational and communication skills require


**About Goldman Sachs**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

title: Finance Associate
description:
**Position Overview** 




 We do not have a finance function yet. Revenue arrives in USD, most of our creator payments go out in USD, and everything in between is currently held together by founders, an external CA firm, and a handful of operational workarounds. This role exists to change that. You will bring day\-to\-day finance in\-house and build the systems that let the business run without the founders in the weeds.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the full USD\-INR cycle end to end: inbound remittances, documentation, outbound creator payments, and cutting forex conversion losses at every step.
* Run internal payroll and creator payouts on a fixed cadence, calculated, checked, and on time, across a large base of US\-based creators and the internal team.
* Build a management information system that reflects how the business actually operates, and reconcile it against the books of accounts and bank cash flows.
* Manage our external CA and CS partners — review their work, catch errors, and keep GST, TDS, FEMA, and statutory filings on track.
* Track invoices raised against receivables collected and flag collection risk early.
* Hunt down cost leaks — bank commissions, idle cash, avoidable consultant spend — and propose better structures with clear trade\-offs.
* Write finance and admin SOPs from scratch where none exist, and rebuild the ones that no longer hold.
* Own finance and administration operations end to end, escalating only what genuinely needs a founder decision.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




**Must\-Have** 



* CA, CPA, or ACCA — completed or actively tracking toward it.
* **CA freshers post\-articleship are welcome; other backgrounds should bring roughly one to three years of relevant experience.**
* Working command of accounting fundamentals and what the numbers actually mean for a business, not just how they are calculated.
* Practical understanding of GST, TDS, and cross\-border payment documentation.
* Ability to define a problem and its constraints end to end before reaching for a solution.
* Clear, fluent English — you will interact directly with US\-based creators, vendors, and partners.
* Comfort building process from scratch in an environment that is still being figured out.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Exposure to cross\-border remittances, treasury, or forex cost optimisation.
* Experience in a high\-growth startup or an execution\-heavy advisory or transaction\-services team.
* Hands\-on experience preparing an MIS and reconciling it with the books.
* Familiarity with payroll and creator or vendor payout platforms.



  





**Logistics** 



* **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
* **Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
* **Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
* **Department:** 
 Finance and Administration
* **Working Pattern:** 
 Six\-day work week for the coming months
* **Experience:** 
 CA freshers post\-articleship, or one to three years for other backgrounds

**Job Purpose**
 The Senior – Techno Functional Expert \- Yardi will act as the primary subject matter expert for the Yardi platform, supporting finance and accounting operations for a large global real estate environment. The role will combine strong Yardi functional knowledge with technical administration, configuration, reporting, integration, controls, and production support capability.
   

  

 The position will partner with Finance Operations, Onshore teams, IT, Yardi consultants, and third\-party application teams to ensure system stability, process efficiency, governance, automation, and continuous improvement across Yardi\-enabled finance processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the primary Yardi SME for finance and accounting processes, including Accounts Payable, Cash Operations, General Accounting, Fixed Assets, Loans, Tax, Treasury, and reporting\-related activities.
* Provide functional leadership for Yardi\-enabled process design, issue resolution, configuration changes, workflow improvements, and business requirement translation.
* Manage Yardi administration activities including user access governance, security roles, system settings, configurations, periodic reviews, and platform health checks.
* Analyse and resolve complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, coordinate with Yardi support/IT teams, and maintain documentation of known issues and resolutions.
* Configure and support key Yardi areas such as vendors, approval workflows, payment processes, accounting structures, property/entity setup, banking, tax, loans, and fixed assets.

title: Lead Finance Functional Consultant – D365 F&O
description:
Join the digital revolution with ERBrains Business Solutions, where we're not just transforming businesses – we're shaping the future of digital innovation!
   

  

**About Us**
 At ERBrains, we're all about driving business transformation and re\-engineering processes to pave the way for tomorrow's digital landscape. Our expertise spans ERP Consulting, Implementation, and Managed Services, utilising cutting\-edge platforms which includes ERP Consulting, Implementation and Managed Services using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Cloud Consulting, Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Dynamics 365\. With a powerhouse team of over 120 professionals across ERBrains India, Dubai, UAE, and the USA, and over a decade of Microsoft Gold Competency in IT Service Management, we're primed to lead the charge into tomorrow's digital era!
   

  

**Job Description: Lead Finance Functional Consultant – D365 F\&O**
**Position or Title:** 
 Lead Finance Functional Consultant – D365 F\&O
   

  

**Department/Practice:** 
 D365 Finance \& Operations
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–12 years in ERP, with deep hands\-on D365 F\&O Finance delivery
   

  

**Track Record:** 
 4\+ full\-cycle ERP implementations delivered, rapid\-implementation approach
   

  

**Engagement:** 
 Owns the finance workstream of a project single\-handedly, end\-to\-end
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Delivery Head / Practice Lead
   

  

**Work Location:** 
 Bangalore (hybrid) – with domestic \& international travel as projects require
   

  

**About This Role**
 This is not a seat on a large bench of consultants. We are looking for a senior finance consultant who can take a project's entire finance scope onto their own shoulders and deliver it — from the first requirement workshop through to a stable go\-live and the support that follows.
   

  

 You will be the single point of ownership for Finance on your projects. That means you personally run requirement gathering, design the solution, configure the system, drive testing, train the users, lead cutover and go\-live, and stand behind the result. You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the Supply Chain and Technical teams, and you will be the face of the finance solution in front of the customer.
   

  

**What Sets This Role Apart**
 We deliver fast. You should be comfortable running lean, rapid implementations — making confident design decisions, applying proven Microsoft and industry\-standard patterns, and driving a project to go\-live without needing a layer of people underneath you to get the work done.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* What you will own, end to end


 On every engagement, you carry the full finance delivery lifecycle yourself:
   

  

* 
+ Requirement gathering — run discovery and process workshops with the customer; capture, challenge and shape requirements into a clear finance solution design.
+ Fit\-gap \& solution design — map business processes to D365 capability, recommend best\-practice finance processes, and document the design.
+ Configuration \& build — configure the full finance footprint yourself; specify any RICEFW items needed and hand clean requirements to the technical team.
+ Testing — build and execute test scenarios across unit, CRP, SIT and UAT; own defect triage and resolution for the finance scope.
+ Training — prepare materials and train key users and the customer finance team to operate the solution confidently.
+ Cutover \& Go\-Live — plan and run data migration, opening balances, reconciliation and the finance cutover; lead go\-live and hypercare/stabilisation.
+ Documentation — produce the artefacts that make the delivery defensible — FRD/FDD, fit\-gap, configuration workbooks, test scripts, training guides and cutover plans.
+ Delivery ownership — own scope, timeline, risks and quality for the finance stream, and keep the customer and project leadership informed.
+ Core finance modules — hands\-on ownership


 You must be able to design, configure and deliver the following modules yourself, to production\-grade quality:
 

* 
+ General Ledger — chart of accounts, financial dimensions, ledger setup, multi\-entity, multi\-currency, period close
+ Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable — vendor/customer setup, invoicing, payments, settlement and posting profiles
+ Cash \& Bank Management — bank setup, reconciliation, payment formats and cash\-flow control
+ Fixed Assets — asset books, depreciation, acquisition/disposal and integration with the GL
+ Credit \& Collections — credit limits, ageing, collections process and customer follow\-up
+ Management Reporter / Financial Reporting — reporting trees, statutory and management report design
+ Electronic Reporting (ER) — configuring and adapting ER formats for statutory and regulatory output
+ Taxation — the D365 tax engine end\-to\-end: indirect tax (GST/VAT), withholding tax and country\-specific tax treatments
+ Financial setup across operational modules


 Finance Does Not Stop At The Finance Modules. You Own The Financial And Accounting Setup That Sits Behind The Operational Streams, Working Closely With The SCM Team On The Boundary
 

* 
+ Sales / Order\-to\-Cash — posting profiles, revenue and receivable postings, customer accounting.
+ Procurement / Procure\-to\-Pay — vendor posting, purchase accounting, accruals and invoice matching.
+ Production Control — manufacturing postings, WIP, variances and production accounting.
+ Landed Cost — cost components, apportionment and the resulting inventory and financial impact.
+ Inventory Management — inventory posting setup, costing methods (FIFO / Standard / Weighted Average) and inventory close.
+ Project Management \& Accounting — project cost and revenue postings, WIP, and project financial control.
+ Cross\-functional collaboration


 You will not work in isolation — you will work in full collaboration across the project teams:
 

* 
+ Supply Chain (SCM) team — partner closely on the finance\-to\-operations boundary so that sales, procurement, production, inventory and projects all post correctly and reconcile.
+ Technical team — translate finance requirements into clear specifications for customisations, integrations and reports (RICEFW); review designs and validate that the build meets the requirement.
+ Integrations — define finance\-side requirements for banks, payment providers, tax/e\-invoicing portals, Power BI and third\-party systems.
+ Localisation experience


 You should be comfortable delivering across multiple geographies. We expect genuine, hands\-on familiarity with at least 4–5 localisations, including:
 

* 
+ India (GST, TDS/TCS, e\-invoicing, statutory reporting)
+ United States (sales \& use tax, 1099, US GAAP considerations)
+ Europe (VAT, EU reporting, intrastat, country statutory formats)
+ Australia / New Zealand (GST, BAS/GST reporting and local statutory requirements)
+ Customer\-facing expectations


 You are the finance solution in the customer's eyes. We expect you to:
 

* 
+ Engage CFOs, Finance Controllers, Finance Managers and key users with confidence and credibility
+ Lead workshops, walkthroughs, training and steering updates clearly and professionally
+ Set expectations honestly, manage scope conversations, and drive issues to closure
+ Build trust so the customer is confident the finance stream is in safe hands


**Must\-have Qualifications**
* 
+ 4\+ full\-cycle ERP implementations delivered, with hands\-on finance ownership on each.
+ Rapid\-implementation delivery — a track record of taking finance to go\-live efficiently, applying proven patterns rather than reinventing each time.
+ Deep D365 F\&O Finance expertise across all the core modules listed above, configured personally and in production.
+ Multi\-entity, multi\-currency, multi\-tax delivery experience across at least 4–5 localisations.
+ Strong grasp of accounting and finance fundamentals and statutory/compliance requirements — not just the software.
+ Independent delivery — able to own and deliver a finance workstream single\-handedly, with minimal supervision.
+ Excellent communication and a structured, problem\-solving, customer\-first approach.


**Good to have**
* 
+ Power BI for finance reporting
+ Exposure to consolidation, intercompany, revenue recognition or lease/IFRS 15/16 accounting
+ Familiarity with implementation methodologies (Sure Step / LCS / Agile) and tooling (LCS, Azure DevOps, RSAT)
+ Experience with upgrades, rollouts and post go\-live assessments
+ Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g. MB\-310, MB\-300\)


 We provide a stimulating technical environment where you can work with the latest Microsoft technologies. You will play a key role in defining our technical standards and will have opportunities to lead major implementation projects.

title: FP&A Systems Analyst
description:
**Who are we?**
 RZR Global is an AI\-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy\-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The FP\&A Analyst is the execution layer of the FP\&A team. The role exists to do the volume work that keeps the function running every week: data pulls, workbook refreshes, model updates, reconciliations, slide builds, and number checks. The analyst will work directly with the Head of FP\&A, the FP\&A Manager, and the Financial Modelling Analyst, supporting each of them on their workstreams.
   

  

 The work spans five recurring areas:
   

  

* Weekly and monthly forecast cycles. Variance refresh, pacing reconciliation, cash forecast updates, pipeline cross\-checks.
* Models and trackers. Maintain the FY26 to FY28 model, the AOP, the cash forecast, the publisher rebate tracker, the DSP margin builder, the software and subscription tracker, the headcount file, and other recurring workbooks.
* M\&A and corporate development support. Data room organisation, comparable analysis pulls, target lists, Q\&A trackers, synergy schedule maintenance.
* Board, investor, and parent\-co reporting. Number sourcing, slide formatting, trace\-back documentation, first\-pass variance commentary for board books, MBR/QBR decks, and Skillz HQ requests.
* Dashboards and ad hoc analysis. Build and refresh executive dashboards. Turn around fast\-cycle data requests from Aman, Avi, and Jeff.The role is execution\-heavy by design. The right candidate is someone who is happy spending the first twelve months getting the recurring work clean, accurate, and on time, and who earns broader scope by being reliable at the basics.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Weekly and Monthly Forecast Cycles
* Refresh the weekly forecast variance workbook (three\-tab format) by pulling pacing data, updating prior\-week cuts, and producing forecast versus actual deltas.
* Pull and clean HubSpot pipeline exports each week. Apply stage\-based exclusions, owner mapping, and probability weights as defined in the FP\&A SOP. Override Prospecting to 5 percent and apply the launch\-date threshold filter consistent with the existing model.
* Update the 17\-week rolling cash forecast each week with bank balances, AR/AP feeds, and the prior\-cycle variance section.
* Refresh the monthly rolling forecast at month\-end with new actuals, OPEX phasing, and revenue updates.
* Build first\-pass variance commentary for the Head of FP\&A to review.
* Models and Tracker Maintenance
* Maintain the FY26 to FY28 driver\-based financial model with monthly refreshes for actuals, headcount changes, and assumption updates.
* Keep the AOP model current as approved hires, salary changes, and OPEX shifts are confirmed.
* Refresh the publisher rebate tracker each quarter against signed contracts and AR/AP files (InMobi, Vungle/Liftoff, Verve, Chartboost, AdWake).
* Update the DSP margin builder with new client and platform data, including the Client Views, Client Lookup, Summary, and Data tabs.
* Refresh the software and subscription tracker monthly using the NetSuite GL extract.
* Maintain the headcount file: starts, leaves, transfers, salary changes, bonus eligibility, seat status.
* Update the AIN sunset tracker through the run\-off period.
* M\&A and Corporate Development Support
* Build and maintain target screening lists for inbound and outbound deal activity at RZR and Skillz.
* Pull comparable transaction and trading comp data from public sources to support valuation analysis.
* Organise and maintain data rooms during diligence cycles: index, populate, version, and audit.
* Maintain Q\&A trackers and follow\-up logs for live diligence.
* Update synergy schedules and integration cost trackers as inputs come in from operators.
* Support post\-close synergy realisation tracking with monthly refreshes.
* The deeper modelling, valuation judgement, and deal narrative remain with the Head of FP\&A and the VP Finance. The analyst is expected to keep the supporting infrastructure clean and on time.
* Board, Investor, and Parent Reporting
* Pull source numbers for board deck financial slides (revenue, margin, EBITDA, cash, headcount). Document trace\-back for every figure.
* Format board, MBR, and QBR slides to RZR brand standards (Midnight Reactor \#0B1220, Ignition Orange \#FF7000, Acquisition Blue \#01A1F1\).
* Build first drafts of variance commentary for the Head of FP\&A or VP Finance to refine.
* Prepare data packs for Skillz HQ monthly and quarterly reporting.
* Turn around ad hoc investor and board data requests on same\-day or next\-day SLAs.
* Dashboards and Ad Hoc Analysis
* Build and refresh executive dashboards covering revenue, margin, pacing, cash, and headcount.
* Document data lineage, refresh cadence, and known caveats for every dashboard.
* Run ad hoc analysis for Aman, Avi, Jeff, and the Head of FP\&A: bonus calculations, salary calibration refreshes, OPEX deep dives, client\-level margin queries, hiring plan refreshes, cost\-benefit analyses (e.g. Beeswax versus in\-house bidder builds).
* Convert recurring Excel reports into dashboards where the cadence and data stability justify the build.
* Process Discipline
* Hold the line on workbook hygiene: minimal hardcoding, centralised assumptions, version control, clear input/output flow.
* Follow naming conventions, formatting, and tab structure across all FP\&A files.
* Document every recurring workbook with a one\-page logic memo so no file is a single point of failure.
* Catch errors before they leave the team. The analyst is the last line of defence on any number that goes to the CFO, CEO, board, or Skillz.


**Required Skills And Experience**
**Must\-Have**
* 1 to 3 years of experience in FP\&A, audit, transaction services, investment banking, corporate finance, or equivalent. Open to strong fresh CA, MBA, or post\-graduate finance candidates with relevant internship experience.
* Strong Excel and Google Sheets fluency: SUMIFS, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, IFERROR, conditional logic, pivot tables, dynamic ranges.
* Solid finance fundamentals: revenue recognition, accruals and prepaids, working capital, EBITDA, basic cash flow concepts.
* Comfort with raw data: cleaning, reconciling, and pivoting GL or pipeline extracts without losing accuracy.
* Attention to detail. Must be able to spot a number that does not foot before someone senior asks the question.
* Comfortable with high\-volume, deadline\-driven work and frequent priority shifts.
* Clear written communication. The analyst will draft commentary, write source memos, and email cross\-functional partners every week.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Exposure to mobile advertising, programmatic DSPs, gaming, AdTech, or subscription/SaaS business models.
* SQL or Python at a basic level for raw\-data extraction.
* BI tool experience: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar.
* Prior support of board reporting, investor materials, or M\&A diligence.
* Familiarity with NetSuite, HubSpot, or other ERP/CRM extracts.
* CA, CFA Level 1 or 2, or an MBA finance specialisation.
